name: Drilling automation and autonomous rigs
principle: Software closes the loop between downhole sensing, rig control and well placement so the system adjusts weight on bit, rotation and hydraulics, and increasingly well trajectory, with limited human input. Halliburton reports 23.4% higher average ROP in three years of autonomous directional drilling on four Norwegian Continental Shelf rigs; these are company claims.

performance.metric: average ROP, automated vs conventional (Halliburton NCS)
performance.basis: 36.71 vs 29.75 m/h over three years, four rigs; vendor figure

source.note: AVEVA, When the rig starts thinking: the rise of autonomous drilling (vendor-authored; company claims relayed)
